topic: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Limit & Scale of Finance
summary: Explains how farmer credit limit is calculated based on operational land area, crop type, cost of cultivation, post-harvest maintenance and household consumption.

key_formulas.first_year_limit: Scale of Finance for crop x Cultivated Area + 10% towards post-harvest/household + 20% towards farm asset maintenance
key_formulas.5_year_sanction: Automatic 10% annual escalation over base limit for successive years without fresh mortgage/documentation

interest_rates.base_rate: 7.0% per annum for credit up to ₹3,00,000
interest_rates.prompt_repayment_incentive: 3.0% interest subvention credited back upon repayment on or before due date

warning: Never pay cash processing fees to unauthorized middlemen for KCC issuance. PACS charges are statutorily regulated.
citations: RBI Master Circular - Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme

topic: Safe Digital Banking & Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
summary: Essential safety rules for farmers using micro-ATMs at PACS, AEPS (Aadhaar Enabled Payment System), and UPI for agricultural payments.
safety_rules: Never share OTP or banking PIN with anyone, including individuals claiming to be bank or cooperative society managers.
Check SMS confirmation for debit/credit amounts immediately after biometric fingerprint authentication at PACS micro-ATM.
Ensure DBT Aadhaar seeding is linked only with your primary active bank account.
citations: NPCI Guidelines for Cooperative Bank AEPS
